# Fenced Star Autopair

Prevents `*` from auto-pairing inside Markdown backtick fences. It inserts one literal `*` instead. Outside fenced code blocks, Obsidian handles `*` and every other editor behavior normally.

## Install

1. Copy the entire `fenced-star-autopair` folder into your vault at `.obsidian/plugins/`.
2. In Obsidian, open **Settings → Community plugins** and enable **Fenced Star Autopair**.
3. Reload Obsidian or reload plugins if it does not appear immediately.

The installed layout must be:

```text
.obsidian/plugins/fenced-star-autopair/manifest.json
.obsidian/plugins/fenced-star-autopair/main.js
```
